title: The queen
outcomes: Taps every square a queen can reach, stopping in front of its own pieces and on the first enemy piece
Rejects a knight-shaped jump for the queen
Tells whether a blocker on one line affects the queen's other lines

steps.say: Slide the queen to the star.
Straight, then diagonal. The queen can do both.

steps.text: The queen moves like a rook and a bishop together: any distance, straight or diagonal. In one move she picks one line and stays on it; she cannot turn a corner.

steps.say: Take the pawn on the star, then reach the other one.

steps.caption: Every lit square is a place the queen can go: 23 in all. Her own pawn on f2 stops her on e3 and shuts the line to g1. The black pawn on d6 can be taken, but d7 and d8 are behind it, out of reach.

claims.statement: From d4 the queen reaches these squares and no others.

steps.caption: The pawn on d2 shuts the queen's line up the d-file, and only that line. She still slides along the first rank and along both diagonals. A blocker closes only its own line.

claims.statement: The queen cannot go up the d-file past her own pawn.
From d1 the queen reaches exactly these squares, on her open lines.

steps.prompt: Say it back: how does the queen move, and what happens when a piece is in the way?

steps.text: **Model answer.** The queen moves like a rook and a bishop together. Any line is open until a piece blocks it: she stops before her own piece and takes an enemy piece. A blocker closes only its own line, and the other lines stay open. A legal square is not always a safe one; that comes later.

sources: Rebuilt as a star-grab lesson on 8 Nov 2026 (docs/reach-step.md); wording original.
Queen movement is a rule of the game; the board's destination set is a legal_destinations claim [V].
Every reach round is solved by tools/validate_lessons.py (legal moves, par) [V]; the learning effect of moving first is a design bet [I].
The id says QUEENKING for historical reasons: this lesson teaches the queen only; the king has its own lesson, L-FND-PIECE-KING-1.
